answer: Resist Sybils with continuous service-availability proofs: each identity must answer a steady share of real service requests within strict latency bounds, like a plume of smoke that must keep rising to prove the fire is real. Standing grows only from sustained, verified service, recorded as a marble-solid history that cannot be bought overnight. A basalt-hard floor of minimum uptime stops idle fakes, so running thousands of identities costs thousands of live servers, bandwidth, and upkeep, while one honest agent needs only its own single working node.
